subject.title: [security] Vultr redirects can disclose API credentials to subdomains

question: Should this conditional provider-credential redirect disclosure be handled through the repository’s security-response process before normal issue implementation is considered?
rationale: The report concerns a potentially reusable provider API credential and requires confirmation of an exploit-relevant trust boundary, severity, disclosure handling, and the appropriate remediation timeline.

options.title: Route for confidential security triage
options.body: Verify the current Vultr redirect behavior privately or with an approved security owner, then decide on disclosure and remediation handling.

options.title: Handle as normal P2 hardening
options.body: Treat the report as a public conditional hardening issue if the security owner confirms the stated preconditions do not require coordinated handling.

recommendation.title: Route for confidential security triage
recommendation.body: Verify the current Vultr redirect behavior privately or with an approved security owner, then decide on disclosure and remediation handling.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter is the only identified technical contact in the available evidence; current code-history ownership still needs a targeted history pass.
